cell.help: [column, row] of a cell of the sheet, counted from 0.

joinBlocks.help: Joined edges: the top-left cell of a 4 x 4 block of cells (8 x 8 on hexagons), or a list of such blocks as animation frames.

node.help: [column, row] of the block's top-left cell.
The top-left cell of each block, one per animation frame.

standVariants.help: Several pictures or several models; one is picked per square.

node.help: Cells [column, row], one picked per square.
Model files (.glb or .gltf in the game folder), one picked per square.

terrainLook.help: How a terrain looks (exactly one of cell, variants, frames, join).

sheet.help: The sheet the picture is in.

variants.help: Several pictures; one is picked per square.

frames.help: An animation: these cells one after the other (see frameMs).

frameMs.help: Milliseconds per frame of an animation.

joinWith.help: Joins with these terrains as well as itself (join only).

joinExcept.help: Joins with every terrain except these (join only).

joinEdge.help: The map edge counts as a neighbour of the same terrain (join only).

stand.help: Something that stands on the squares in 3D styles (trees, rocks).

standLook.help: An upright thing on a terrain in a 3D style: a picture or a 3D model.

sheet.help: The sheet of an upright picture.

model.help: A 3D model: a .glb or .gltf file inside the game folder.

turn.help: Degrees the model is turned (a model only).

width.help: Width in pixels (an upright picture only).

scatter.help: Placed at random spots in the square.

spriteLook.help: A picture of a unit or structure: one cell, or an animation.

sheet.help: The sheet the picture is in.

frames.help: An animation: these cells one after the other.

sides.help: Another picture for a side of the map (by side id).

walk.help: Frames while the unit moves (down, up and side or left / right).

sheet.help: The sheet of the walk frames (default: the picture's own).

side.help: Frames walking right; left is the same turned round.

modelLook.help: A 3D model of a unit or structure.

model.help: A .glb or .gltf file inside the game folder.

sideMaterial.help: Name of the model's material that takes the side's colour.

unitThing.help: The art of a unit type: a 3D model, a picture, or none.

structureThing.help: The art of a structure: a 3D model, a picture, or none.

terrainEntry.help: The art of a terrain, or none.

portraitLook.help: A portrait: one cell, with optional talking and blinking frames.

sheet.help: The sheet the portrait is in.

faces.help: The way the picture looks, so the game can mirror it.

talk.help: Frames shown while the person talks (1 to 8).

blink.help: Frames shown when the person blinks (1 to 8).

iconLook.help: An icon: one cell of a sheet, drawn before the weapon's or item's name in lists.

sheet.help: The sheet the icon is in.

artSet.help: Art by id: terrain, units, structures and portraits.

units.help: The picture or model of each unit type.

structures.help: The picture or model of each structure.

portraits.help: Portraits by id (a character's id or the name a say line uses).

sheets.help: The picture files (.png in the game folder), cut into cells.

id.help: Unique id the art below names the sheet by.

file.help: A .png file inside the game folder, such as art/tiles.png.

cellWidth.help: Width of one cell in pixels.

cellHeight.help: Height of one cell in pixels.

smooth.help: Scaled smoothly (for painted art) instead of with hard pixels.

name.help: Display name of the image in the editors (the engine does not read it).

unitMarker.help: Draw the side's colour marker under a unit's picture.

backgrounds.help: Story backgrounds by id (letters, digits, _ and -): a whole sheet or one cell.

cell.help: One cell of it (default: the whole sheet).

badges.help: A small picture drawn on the map sprite of the units that carry a tag (a boss marker). The same in every style.

cell.help: One cell of it (default: the whole sheet image).

tag.help: A unit type's tag or a character's tag; every unit with it wears the badge.

anchor.help: Which corner of the unit's square the same corner of the badge goes on.

offset.help: [x, y]: moved by this many pixels of one square of the game's tile size (it scales with the zoom).

markers.help: A small picture an event puts on the squares of its reach area ("something of interest here"): name it in the event's "marker".

cell.help: One cell of it (default: the whole sheet image).

anchor.help: Which point of the square the same point of the picture goes on.

offset.help: [x, y]: moved by this many pixels of one square of the game's tile size (it scales with the zoom).

tilesets.help: Tilesets of a map's tile layer by id: a sheet whose cells are numbered tiles.

frames.help: Tile numbers shown one after the other (2 to 64).

terrain.help: How each terrain looks in the flat views.

units.help: The picture of each unit type.

portraits.help: Portraits by id (a character's id or the name a say line uses).

icons.help: Icons by weapon or item id: the small picture before the name in item lists.

styles.help: Art of a visual style of game.json: what it replaces (flat styles) or all it has (3D styles).
